│ # intpot CLI                                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│ Use the `intpot` command for project scaffolding, serving `intpot.App`,      │
│ inspecting trusted framework apps, and conversion/ejection. This procedure   │
│ covers consumer workflows; detailed product behavior and version-specific    │
│ API are in (references/upstream.md).                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ ## When to use                                                               │
│ - User requests CLI-based setup, serving, inspection, or conversion among    │
│ Typer, FastAPI, and FastMCP.                                                 │
│ - Use `intpot-python` for Python API operations inside a script or codebase. │
│ - Do not convert code the user does not trust; discovery imports and         │
│ executes source modules.                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│ ## Setup and version check                                                   │
│ 1. Use the project's existing environment and dependency policy. Install     │
│ `intpot` there, or install `intpot`, `intpot`, or `intpot` when the          │
│ source/target framework must be loaded or run.                               │
│ 2. Check `intpot --version` and `intpot --help`; consult the pinned guide    │
│ for required feature versions. If the package is older than a feature's      │
│ stated minimum, do not assume it exists. When published release diverges     │
│ from this pinned snapshot, use a matching upstream source checkout at the    │
│ pinned revision or a compatible published version; never silently mix docs   │
│ and runtime.                                                                 │
│ 3. Confirm source and intended output paths. Preserve existing files; use    │
│ `--dry-run` for conversion previews.                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ ## Procedure                                                                 │
│ 1. For a new project, run `intpot init <name> --type cli|api|mcp` with one   │
│ type; inspect generated files.                                               │
│ 2. For an existing `intpot.App`, run `intpot serve <file.py>                 │
│ --cli|--api|--mcp`. CLI tool arguments follow mode flags; use `--` if app    │
│ flags collide with intpot options. API defaults to loopback; network         │
│ exposure requires an explicit host choice.                                   │
│ 3. For framework conversion, run `intpot inspect <source> --json` (or the    │
│ table form), review extracted tools and diagnostics, then run `intpot to     │
│ cli|api|mcp <source> [--output ...]`. Preview with `--dry-run`. For          │
│ standalone export from an `intpot.App`, use `intpot eject <source> --to      │
│ cli|api|mcp`.                                                                │
│ 4. Treat refusals as meaningful. Missing bodies/bindings, CLI callbacks,     │
│ FastAPI dependency injection, and other unsupported cases can prevent        │
│ conversion before writes. `--allow-scaffold` only opts into explicitly       │
│ failing `NotImplementedError` stubs for eligible missing-body recovery; it   │
│ does not bypass callback, dependency, or binding refusals. Never present a   │
│ scaffold as working output.                                                  │
│ 5. Verify every generated file: compile it, import it in the target runtime  │
│ environment, and execute a representative CLI invocation, API request, or    │
│ MCP tool call. Help text, generation success, and compilation alone do not   │
│ prove behavior.                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ ## Failure boundaries and safety                                             │
│ - Inspection/conversion imports trusted source. `--dry-run` prevents         │
│ generated output writes, not source execution; it is not a sandbox.          │
│ - Before retrying a refusal, check output is absent/unchanged. Avoid         │
│ overwriting user output without consent.                                     │
│ - Direct file loading may not put the source directory on `sys.path`;        │
│ sibling imports can require installing the project or setting `PYTHONPATH`.  │
│ Intpot does not provision services/configuration.                            │
│ - Recovery scope is version-dependent and bounded. The pinned snapshot       │
│ documents v0.11 helper recovery for required undecorated functions and       │
│ immutable literal constants, including supported transitive helpers. It      │
│ excludes mutable/dynamic state, closures, classes and other unsupported      │
│ dependencies. Do not repeat older blanket claims that all same-module        │
│ helpers are unsupported, nor infer universal helper copying. Consult the     │
│ versioned reference and actual diagnostics.                                  │
│ - Framework semantic gaps remain, including nested Typer sub-apps,           │
│ repeatable CLI options, certain FastAPI parameter forms, factory apps,       │
│ multi-method routes, callbacks, and dependencies.                            │
│                                                                              │
│ ## Verification report                                                       │
│ Record installed version, source/target, command/output path,                │
│ diagnostics/refusals, and real behavior exercised. State unverified          │
│ frameworks and limitations; distinguish generated, compiled, imported, and   │
│ behaviorally tested.                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ ## Reference                                                                 │
│ - [Pinned complete upstream public guide](references/upstream.md)            │
│ - [Complete upstream MIT notice](references/LICENSE.md)                      │
│                                                                              │
